title.purpose: Page/section headers only; system has no display/hero scale.

body.purpose: Reading text, form values, card content, buttons.

label.purpose: Field labels, chips, badges, timestamps — always mono/uppercase, the system's signature.

shadows.name: modal-overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs/modals — the only heavy elevation in the system.

motion.name: color-fade
motion.purpose: Default transition for button/chip/input color and border-color changes; no transform or shadow motion on buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #1A1A18; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(26,26,24,.08); outline: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #D8D4C6; color: #4A4A3F; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1A1A18; color: #1A1A18; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggleable filter pill (All / To fill / Filled).
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid #D8D4C6; background: #FFFFFF; color: #4A4A3F; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-on { background: #1A1A18; color: #fff; border-color: #1A1A18; }

components.name: Launcher Card
components.description: Home-screen app launcher card with hover lift.
components.html:
Delivery Tracker
Daily delivery tracking by outlet
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D8D4C6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 22px; display: block; text-decoration: none; color: #1A1A18; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #1A1A18; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #4A4A3F; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Delivery Row (stateful)
components.description: Compact list row with a functional left-border state indicator (green = filled).
components.css: .ds-row { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D8D4C6; border-left: 3px solid #D8D4C6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 12px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-row-filled { border-left-color: #2E7D32; } .ds-row-idx { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #6B6B60; min-width: 15px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with label above, blends into background at rest.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #4A4A3F; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #D8D4C6; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; background: #F4F1EA; color: #1A1A18; outline: none; transition: border 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1A1A18; background: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: A digitized clipboard, not a startup dashboard: dense, bordered, monospace-labeled, built to be scanned fast under time pressure by kitchen staff mid-shift, not admired. The whole system reads as a paper form that happens to sync in real time — flat surfaces, hairline borders, uppercase mono micro-labels doing the job a printed form's field labels would, color reserved for state (filled vs. not, error vs. ok) rather than decoration. It explicitly rejects the generic AI-SaaS look: no gradient hero metrics, no glassmorphism, no eyebrow labels, no eyeball-catching flourishes — this tool serves an operational workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral paper background with near-black ink text and accents — a physical, printed-form feel, not a cool SaaS-app feel.
Mono labels everywhere secondary/meta info appears — a distinct 'form field' register separate from the sans body/UI text.
Flat by default; shadow appears only as a hover lift or a modal's real elevation, never decoratively.
Color is a state signal (filled/unfilled, error, role badge), not a palette exercise — the accent is used sparingly and functionally.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: There is one true accent color (Ink, near-black) used for primary actions and active state. Signal Orange and Signal Red exist only for specific semantic meaning — never as decorative alternates to Ink.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Color outside the neutral ramp appears only to signal state — never as a decorative palette choice.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Anything functioning as a form field label, a chip, a badge, or a timestamp is set in mono, uppercase, letter-spaced 0.06em — never the body sans.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-It-Floats Rule
rules.body: Shadows only appear on things that are actually elevated (a modal) or actively responding to interaction (a hover lift, a focus ring). A static card at rest never has a shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent to Ink alone for primary/active state; reserve Signal Orange and Signal Red for their specific semantic roles only.
Do set every label, badge, chip, and timestamp in the mono Label style.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; shadow only for genuine elevation or active interaction.
Do maintain ≥4.5:1 contrast on Text Tertiary and any body copy against Paper.
Do treat the list-row left-border color as a state signal only.
donts: Don't add gradient hero metrics, glassmorphism, or eyebrow labels.
Don't introduce a second saturated 'brand' accent alongside Ink.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored decorative stripe on non-stateful cards or callouts.
Don't set field labels, chips, or badges in the body sans font 'for consistency'.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons at rest.
